question: Which café comes up first when traveling toward Lore Degenstein Art Gallery, Selinsgrove, PA from Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.909905 40.667715)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.875791 40.797251)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.909905 40.667715)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.909905 40.667715)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA

[3].display_name: Lore Degenstein Art Gallery, Selinsgrove, PA
